title.zh: 频率响应与滤波 · 按频率挑食的盒子
title.en: Frequency Response & Filters · A Box That Eats by Frequency

desc.zh: LTI 系统对正弦只做两件事：按 |H(ω)| 缩放、按 φ(ω) 迟到。把这两条曲线量出来，你就既会读波特图，也会按指标亲手设计一个滤波器——零点、相位、带通、验收，全是真算。
desc.en: An LTI system does only two things to a sine: scale it by |H(ω)| and delay it by φ(ω). Measure those two curves and you can both read a Bode plot and design a filter to spec — zeros, phase, bandpass, and a bench verdict, all computed for real.
